doc.title: Pantry thresholds: oats and rice at half

segments.exact: The one-third restock threshold from the 1 October call stays for every shelf except oats and rice, which now restock at half full. Those two run out fastest, and a third full is less than a day of stock on a Friday.

circumstance.context: Pantry restock thresholds; note recording a change from the 1 October call's one-third rule

segments.note: One move: records the threshold decision together with its stated rationale; kept as one segment per the one-act rule.
